an4.158:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an4.158:1.3: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an4.158:2.1: yo hi ko ci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ
an4.158:2.5: rāgavepullataṃ, dosavepullataṃ, mohavepullataṃ, gambhīresu kho panassa ṭhānāṭhānesu paññācakkhuṃ na kamati.
an4.158:2.6: yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ
an4.158:3.1: yo hi ko ci āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ
an4.158:3.5: rāgatanuttaṃ, dosatanuttaṃ, mohatanuttaṃ, gambhīresu kho panassa ṭhānāṭhānesu paññācakkhuṃ kamati.
an4.158:3.6: yo hi ko ci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ
